characters.role: The central figure — the traveler who gathers Baul, Fakir, Udasi, Vairagi, and home-leaver into one
characters.psychological_depth: Serene, detached, wise; walks without owning the path, practices without claiming the fruit, loves without chaining the beloved.

characters.role: The storyteller who frames each workshop and narrates the spiritual story
characters.psychological_depth: A bridge between the modern frame and the spiritual narrative; carries the voice of the road.

characters.role: The modern inquirer who asks the central question and is changed by each story
characters.psychological_depth: Restless, questioning, skeptical yet open; represents the reader's own search for meaning.

characters.role: The wind-touched wanderer who breaks social chains to seek the person of the heart
characters.psychological_depth: Divinely restless, mad with freedom, eyes raised upward while feet remain on earth.

characters.role: The poor one whose poverty releases attachment and lightens the heart
characters.psychological_depth: Intoxicated with divine love; wants nothing except freedom from wanting.

characters.role: The unattached one who walks the road without claiming it
characters.psychological_depth: Impartial, unentangled; loves without turning love into possession.

characters.role: The one who has turned away from worldly attachment and wishes to wake from the dream
characters.psychological_depth: Clear-eyed, detached; sees the world as a dream and seeks waking, not sorrow.

characters.role: The traveler who does not mistake shelter for truth; the true departure is inward
characters.psychological_depth: Courageous, inward-turning; leaves pride, name, possession, caste, fear, and habit.
